verses.text: For the music director, to the tune of “Mahalath.” A psalm for reflection by David. The fool says in their heart, “There is no God.” They’re corrupt and do terrible wrong. No one does good.
God looks down from heaven on humanity to see if anyone understands and seeks him.
Everyone has turned away. Together they’ve become corrupt. No one does good. No one at all.
Don’t these evildoers understand? They devour my people as casually as they eat bread, and they never call on God.
Terror seized them where there was nothing to fear. God scattered the bones of those who camped against you. You put them to shame because God rejected them.
If only Israel’s rescue would come from Zion! When God brings his people back from captivity, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
